executiveSummary: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are now available for pre-order, with shipping estimates slipping to October for some configurations. OpenAI's Sam Altman confirmed that the company will not go public in 2026. AI development is slowing down, with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposing a three-step plan to 'pace the frontier'.

takeaways.title: iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders
takeaways.description: Pre-orders for the new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have begun, with shipping estimates slipping to October for some configurations. This affects customers who pre-ordered right when pre-orders began, according to 9to5Mac.

takeaways.title: OpenAI's future plans
takeaways.description: OpenAI's Sam Altman confirmed that the company will not go public in 2026, contrary to earlier reports. This news is relevant to engineers and tech professionals who are interested in the development of AI technology.

takeaways.title: AI development slowdown
takeaways.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a three-step plan to 'pace the frontier' in AI development, suggesting a slowdown in the pace of AI advancement. This is a significant development for engineers and tech professionals who are working on AI-related projects.

worthWatching: The impact of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max on the smartphone market is worth watching, as it will likely shape the future of mobile technology.
The development of AI technology is an area that will continue to be closely watched in the coming years, as it has the potential to revolutionize many industries.
engineeringPerspective: The use of C2 cellular modem in the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max is a significant technological advancement, as it enables faster data transfer rates and improved performance.

The shift towards more sustainable and energy-efficient hardware designs is an area that engineers and tech professionals should be paying close attention to, as it has the potential to reduce electronic waste and improve the overall sustainability of technology.
